title: Concept: Access-Control-Allow-Headers permits Authorization
description: Permitting Authorization in the preflight allow-list lets the browser send the caller credential cross-origin, so the origin allow-list now decides who may act with that credential.
risk: An allow-listed origin reads authenticated data with the user token, and any origin reflected into Access-Control-Allow-Origin receives that capability; MEDIUM because the allow-list still has to admit the origin.
